architecture.raw_pcm: 4352-frame physical ring: 2048 RAM32K + 2304 RAM9K frames. Unchanged refill <=4096, at most 128 decoded frames/sector plus one registered pending write; legal occupancy <=4225.
architecture.small_histories: One byte-wide true-dual RAM9K for repair and one for pitch FIR; original values/precision and 1215-sample dry delay retained. Repair adds 128 work clocks.
architecture.pitch: Cubic points use one distributed RAM read port over four clocks. Coefficients use one synchronous RAM9K ROM. Exact 33-bit FIR accumulators.
architecture.graphics: Explicit bounded intermediates and shared alpha saturation/reflection. Eleven effects preserve exact coordinates and pixels.
